learning_outcomes.text: provide computations on limits, derivatives, integrals, differential equations, series

syllabus_topics: Complex numbers: algebraic and trigonometrical form, exponential form, operations, roots of unity
Invertible, even, odd, periodic, monotone functions
Limits and convergence criteria for series
Derivative of a function: definition and applications
Graph of a function: maxima and minima
Second order linear differential equations with constant coefficients
assessment_rules: The final exam consists of a written test and an oral examination. The written test involves solving exercises and answering multiple-choice questions. The oral examination further checks preparation and may include exercises, definitions, fundamental examples, counterexamples, and statement and proof of theorems. Both parts must be taken in the same session.
bibliography: M.Bramanti, C.D.Pagani, S.Salsa: Analisi Matematica 1, Zanichelli, 2014.
S.Salsa, A.Squellati: "Esercizi di Analisi Matematica 1", Zanichelli, 2014
M.Bramanti: Esercitazioni di Analisi Matematica 1, Ed. Esculapio, Bologna, 2011.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Informatica (Electronic And Computer Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
